verdict.rationale: The docs show a detailed request log. You can search it by request ID, filter by model, provider, or status, follow requests live, open a single request to see its routing, and export to CSV or JSON. The gateway also logs spend, model usage, and observability metrics in aggregate. The evidence does not show that each logged entry carries its latency, token counts, and cost, nor that request and response payloads can be inspected. Missing for 10: per-request latency/token/cost fields on log entries, request/response body inspection, independent or hands-on corroboration.
